issue_context.title: Inconsistent format of examples in help text
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The format of examples is not consistent.

Here are a few examples:

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/b642da26d0331f6e44af302a6a07eb458df38cd3/pkg/cmd/attestation/trustedroot/trustedroot.go#L57-L59

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/b642da26d0331f6e44af302a6a07eb458df38cd3/pkg/cmd/auth/refresh/refresh.go#L79-L84

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/b642da26d0331f6e44af302a6a07eb458df38cd3/pkg/cmd/api/api.go#L126-L133

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/b642da26d0331f6e44af302a6a07eb458df38cd3/pkg/cmd/cache/list/list.go#L43-L45

### Affected version

```shell
$ gh --version 
gh version 2.67.0 (2025-02-11)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.67.0
```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

Run commands from above examples with `--help` flag.

### Expected vs actual behavior

A consistent format should be followed across all commands.

Suggested format:

```
# Description (Sentence case)
$ gh ...
```

### Logs

N/A
comments:
Makes sense to me, thanks for your diligence.

## Acceptance Criteria

**When** I provide a `--help` flag to any command
**Then** the examples section takes the format:

```
# Description (Sentence case)
$ gh ...
```
I wonder if we could add some linting rules to `golangci-lint` for this.

> I wonder if we could add some linting rules to `golangci-lint` for this.

Checked the supported `golangci-lint` [linters](https://golangci-lint.run/usage/linters/) and none seem to support such cases.
